generalCriterionList.description: Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 CONTINUED FOR 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24(As per circular from Govt. of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bangaluru Dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP-PORTAL format has No Options to add GST Separately at stage of Draft Tender Schedule Process for Over All amount put to Tender, tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. But the item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. Hence the bidder has quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement portal
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts Labour, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall beexecuted as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all the necessary original documents mentioned above to the Executive engineer
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-1 K.P.W.D. and further orders thereon.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Materials like bitumen steel cement etc required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work

The contractor has to quote the same rate to the same items of work that is to be executed at different chainages. If in case, the contractor quotes different rates for the same item appearing at different places of BOQ then, the lowest quoted rate for the same items will be considered for that particular item for evaluation and payment.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
This work is reserved for Scheduled Caste only
The contractor should up-load Caste Certificate of Scheduled Caste Compulsory.

The Contractor belonging to Scheduled Caste shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years He should scan & upload Domicile Residential Certificate for Residing in Karnataka for more than 10 years by the Competent Authority.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tender should be a KPWD Registered Class-IV and above contractorAttach Registration Certificate

Annual Turnover Certificates of last 5 years i.e. period of 2021-22 to 2025-26 Attach Balance sheets & Profit & Loss account statements indicating the contract receipts related to civil engineering construction works duly certified by the chartered accountant.

To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer should have in his name in the last five years, satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least Any Construction work of value not less than Rs. 1.69 lakhs. Attach Work done Certificate issued by competent authority of rank not less than Executive Engineer.
The requisite E.M.D. as prescribed in KPP portal should be submitted by the contractor.
Statement showing the Existing commitments and ongoing works, in the prescribed proformaas per 1.3 A of Section 3 of Qualification information should be furnished.
Statement showing Details of works for which tenders are already submitted in the prescribed proformaas per 1.3 B of Section 3 of Qualification information should be furnished.
This work is reserved for Scheduled Caste only
The contractor should up-load Caste Certificate of Scheduled Caste Compulsory.

The Contractor belonging to Scheduled Caste shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years He should scan & upload Domicile Residential Certificate for Residing in Karnataka for more than 10 years by the Competent Authority.

itemList.description: Retro-Reflectorised Traffic Signs - Providing    and    fixing    of    retro-    reflectorised    cautionary, mandatory  and  informatory  sign  as  per  IRC:67:2022  made of  Class  B  Type  IV  retro  reflective  sheeting  fixed  over   2  mm thick aluminium sheeting vide clause 803.1, 3mm/4mm thick Aluminium composite material sheet depending on the size of the  sign  fixed  over  the  back  support  frame  of  min  25  x  25  x 3mm  angle  mounted  on  a  mild  steel  circular  pipe  65  NB,  3.2 mm thickness firmly fixed to the ground by means of properly designed foundation with M25 grade cement concrete 45 cm x 45 cm x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing.The  sign  shall  be  maintained  as  per  section  12  of IRC:67:2022 - 90 cm equilateral triangle. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 801 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 806 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Supplying  and  Fixing  of  Molded  Shank  Raised  Pavement Markers / Cats Eye made of polycarbonate and ABS moulded body and reflective panels with micro prismatic lens capable of providing total internal reflection of the light entering the lens face and shall support a load of 16000 kg tested in accordance to  ASTM  D  4280  Type  H  and  complying  to  Specifications  of Category   A   of   MORTH   Circular   No   RW/NH/33023/10-97 DO III Dt 11.06. 1997. The height, width and length shall not exceed 50 mm, 100 mm and 102 +/- 2 mm and with minimum reflective  area  of  13  cm2  on  each  side  and  the  slope  to  the base shall be 35 +/- 5 degree. The strength of detachment of the  integrated  cylindrical  shanks,  (of  diameter  not  less  than 19  +/-  2  mm  and  height  not  less  than  30+/-  2  mm)  from the  body  is  to  be  a  minimum  value  of  500  Kg.  Fixing  will  be by  drilling  holes  on  the  road  for  the  shanks  to  go  inside, without  nails  and  using  epoxy  resin  based  adhesive  as  per manufacturers recommendation and complete as directed by the engineer.The contractor shall submit a two year warranty for    satisfactory    field    performance    including    stipulated retro-reflectance   of   the   reflecting   panel,   to   the   Engineer. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - MoRTH 806 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

itemList.description: Chevron Boards - Supply  and  installation  of  retro-  reflective  Chevron  signboards of 600x450mm made out of cube corner micro prismatic grade sheeting confirming to Type XI standards of IRC:67:2022 & ASTM D  4956-09  specification  &  fixed  over  3  mm  thick  Aluminium Composite Panel sheet having minimum 0.30 mm thick aluminum skin  on  both  sides  &  fixed  over  back  support  frame  of  25x25x 3mm MS angle frame. Supported on 75 mm dia OR 75x75x6mm Mild steel with clear height of not less than 2.1 m from the ground level to the bottom of the Sign board & 60 cm below ground level. The sign post should be painted with one coat of red oxide paint and  two  coats  of  synthetic  enamel  paint  of  black  and  white  colour with bands of 30 cm height, firmly fixed to the ground by means of foundation with M 20 grade cement, concrete foundation size of 45 cm  x  45  cm  x  60  cm  including  cost  &  conveyance  of  all  materials, equipment,machinery & Labour with all leads and lifts for satisfactory completion of the work as directed by Engineer incharge. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work
